InputListRoot.description: The root that `ComboboxRoot` and `AutocompleteRoot` render. It is exported for those two families; use one of them instead of rendering it directly.

props.kind: `"combobox"` (the value is a chosen option) or `"autocomplete"` (the value is the input's text).
props.mode: How the input completes what is typed. Only an autocomplete reads it; a combobox always filters (`"list"`).
props.defaultValue: The value selected at first, when `value` isn't controlled (combobox).
props.onValueChange: Called with the new value when an option is chosen or the selection cleared (combobox).
props.multiple: Whether any number of values may be selected (combobox).
props.defaultValues: The values selected at first, with `multiple`, when `values` isn't controlled.
props.onValuesChange: Called with the new values, with `multiple`.
props.defaultInputValue: The input's text at first, when `inputValue` isn't controlled.
props.onInputValueChange: Called with the input's new text.
props.open: Whether the popup is open. Pass it with `onOpenChange` to control it.
props.defaultOpen: Whether the popup is open at first, when `open` isn't controlled.
props.onOpenChange: Called after the popup opened or closed.
props.filter: Whether an option labelled `label` matches the query. Default: case- and accent-insensitive "contains".
props.autoHighlight: Whether the first matching option is highlighted as the user types.
props.loop: Whether the arrow keys go from the last option back to the input, and on to the first.
props.openOnInputClick: Whether a click in the input opens the popup.
props.disabled: Whether the input and its buttons are disabled.
props.readOnly: Whether the value can't be changed. The popup doesn't open.
props.required: Whether a value is required for the form to submit.
props.name: The name the selected value is submitted under (combobox).
props.items: The label of each value, when it must be known before the option has rendered.
props.loading: Whether the options are being fetched. See `ComboboxRoot`.

ComboboxRoot.description: Holds the selection, the input's text and the open state, and shares them with the parts inside it through the `combobox` context.

props.defaultValue: The value selected at first, when `value` isn't controlled.
props.onValueChange: Called with the new value when an option is chosen, the input is emptied or Clear is pressed (`null` for no selection).
props.values: With `multiple`: the selected values. Pass it with `onValuesChange` to control them.
props.defaultValues: With `multiple`: the values selected at first, when `values` isn't controlled.
props.onValuesChange: With `multiple`: called with the new values when an option is toggled, a chip removed or the selection cleared.
props.defaultInputValue: The input's text at first, when `inputValue` isn't controlled.
props.onInputValueChange: Called with the input's new text: what was typed, or the label shown after a choice. It is called in a change of its own, after the combobox has taken the text in, so a handler that starts a request (`query := text` read by `await search(query)`) doesn't hold the input, the popup or the highlight while the answer is out.
props.open: Whether the popup is open. Pass it with `onOpenChange` to control it.
props.defaultOpen: Whether the popup is open at first, when `open` isn't controlled.
props.onOpenChange: Called after the popup opened or closed, whatever closed it.
props.disabled: Whether the combobox is disabled. Also disabled inside a disabled `FieldRoot`.
props.readOnly: Whether the selection can't be changed. The popup doesn't open.
props.required: Whether a value must be selected for the form to submit. Validated by an enclosing `FieldRoot`.
props.loading: Whether the options are being fetched: pass `pending? results` (and `results == null` before the first answer) for `results = await search(query)`. `ComboboxEmpty` stays empty, the list is `aria-busy`, and the popup and list carry `data-loading`.

ComboboxInput.description: The text input, with `role="combobox"`. Typing filters the options and opens the popup; the arrow keys move the highlight while focus stays here; Enter chooses the highlighted option.

dataAttributes.data-popup-open: Present while the popup is open.
dataAttributes.data-readonly: Present when the combobox is read-only.
dataAttributes.data-required: Present when a value is required.
dataAttributes.data-disabled: Present when the combobox is disabled.

ComboboxTrigger.description: A button beside the input that opens and closes the popup and leaves focus in the input. It isn't a Tab stop. Give it an `aria-label`.

dataAttributes.data-popup-open: Present while the popup is open.
dataAttributes.data-disabled: Present when the combobox is disabled.
dataAttributes.data-readonly: Present when the combobox is read-only.
dataAttributes.data-required: Present when a value is required.

ComboboxClear.description: A button that clears the selection and the input's text, then focuses the input. It is rendered only while there is something to clear, and isn't a Tab stop. Give it an `aria-label`.

props.keepMounted: Whether to render the button while there is nothing to clear.

dataAttributes.data-popup-open: Present while the popup is open.
dataAttributes.data-disabled: Present when the combobox is disabled.
dataAttributes.data-readonly: Present when the combobox is read-only.
dataAttributes.data-required: Present when a value is required.

ComboboxValue.description: The selected option's label, or the labels joined by ", " with `multiple`. Use it to show the selection somewhere other than the input.

dataAttributes.data-placeholder: Present while nothing is selected and the placeholder is shown.
dataAttributes.data-popup-open: Present while the popup is open.
dataAttributes.data-disabled: Present when the combobox is disabled.
dataAttributes.data-readonly: Present when the combobox is read-only.
dataAttributes.data-required: Present when a value is required.

ComboboxPopup.description: The popup: an element with `popover="manual"`, placed against the input (or `ComboboxChips`) with CSS anchor positioning and at least as wide as it. Style it with `:popover-open` and `@starting-style`. A press inside it keeps focus in the input.

props.alignOffset: How far the popup is moved along the input's edge from its `align` position, in pixels.

dataAttributes.data-empty: Present while no option is rendered (none matches what was typed, or the answer had none).
dataAttributes.data-side: Which side of the input the popup is on: the one asked for, then the one the browser placed it on.
dataAttributes.data-loading: Present while the root's `loading` is true.

ComboboxList.description: The listbox that holds the options. The input's `aria-controls` points at it.

dataAttributes.data-empty: Present while no option is rendered (none matches what was typed, or the answer had none).
dataAttributes.data-loading: Present while the root's `loading` is true; the list is `aria-busy` then too.

ComboboxItem.description: An option. It isn't rendered while it doesn't match what was typed. A press or Enter while it is highlighted chooses it.

props.value: The value the option stands for.
props.disabled: Whether the option can't be highlighted or chosen.

dataAttributes.data-highlighted: Present while the option is highlighted: the input's `aria-activedescendant`.
dataAttributes.data-selected: Present while the option's value is selected.
dataAttributes.data-label: The option's label: what the filter matches and the input shows once chosen.

ComboboxItemIndicator.description: A mark (a check) shown while its option is selected. Hidden from assistive technology.

props.keepMounted: Whether to render it while the option isn't selected too; style it with `data-selected`.

dataAttributes.data-selected: Present while its option is selected.

ComboboxGroup.description: Groups related options under a `ComboboxGroupLabel`. It gets `hidden` while none of its options match.

ComboboxGroupLabel.description: The heading of a group. The group's `aria-labelledby` points at it.

ComboboxEmpty.description: A `role="status"` element whose children show while no option is rendered, except while the root is `loading`: "no results" isn't shown for an answer that hasn't come. The element stays in the document, empty, otherwise.

ComboboxStatus.description: A `role="status"` element with `aria-live="polite"`, for a message about the list, such as a result count.

ComboboxSeparator.description: A horizontal `role="separator"` between options or groups.

ComboboxChips.description: With `multiple`: the container of the chips and the input. When it is there, the popup is anchored to it rather than to the input.

ComboboxChip.description: One selected value. Render one per value in the `combobox` context's `selected`.

props.value: The selected value the chip stands for. `ComboboxChipRemove` inside it removes this value.

dataAttributes.data-disabled: Present when the combobox is disabled.
dataAttributes.data-readonly: Present when the combobox is read-only.

ComboboxChipRemove.description: A button inside a chip that removes its value from the selection. It isn't a Tab stop. Give it an `aria-label`.

ComboboxArrow.description: An element placed on the popup's edge that faces the input, centred on it. It follows the popup when the browser flips it. Give it a shape in CSS and turn it per `data-side`.

dataAttributes.data-side: Which side of the input the popup is on. Absent while the popup is closed.
